source_row.rationale: Attending to a client's spiritual needs and beliefs (which may or may not be tied to organized religion) reflects a holistic, patient-centered approach to nursing care, recognizing that spirituality can be an important source of meaning, coping, and support for many clients, particularly during illness, crisis, or end of life — nurses provide spiritual support respectfully regardless of whether they share the client's specific beliefs, and involve chaplaincy or other spiritual care resources as appropriate.
source_row.source_detail: Role of Spirituality in Holistic Nursing Care
source_row.source_name: ANA — Holistic Nursing: Scope and Standards of Practice, Spiritual Care
